Around [[9 ABY]], a '''mythosaur''' resided in the [[Living Waters]], a sacred place beneath the ruins of the [[capital]] city [[Sundari]] on the [[planet]] [[Mandalore]]. [[Lady]] [[Bo-Katan Kryze]] discovered the legendary [[mythosaur]] when she rescued [[Din Djarin]] from drowning in its depths. Having firmly believed that the mythosaur was but a myth that was only deemed true by the zealots of the orthodox [[Children of the Watch]],<ref name="Chapter 18" /> Kryze did not tell Djarin, a member of the group, about her sighting of the creature, but nevertheless was persuaded to embrace the group's ways.<ref name="Chapter 19">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 19: The Convert}}</ref>
